descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 该任务等同于在控制台创建的数据下载任务，用户可在对应数据表的导出管理页面查看此次下载任务的日志，并下载文件。

- 通过该接口创建下载任务会增加[AMQP消息推送](~~143601~~)，其中`consumerGroupId`请选用`dop_aliyun_group_name`，消息内容包含此次下载任务的执行状态，用户可根据此状态，配合[GetDownloadFile](~~445783~~)接口获取文件下载地址或查看下载任务的异常信息。

## 使用限制

- 同一数据实例下，每次只能创建1个下载任务。待上一个任务执行完成后才能创建新的下载任务，否则会提示超过下载任务数限制异常。

- 单次下载数据时间范围最多为3天。

- 1天内只能创建3个下载任务，RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

- This job is equivalent to a data download job created in the console. You can view the log of this download job and download the file on the export management page of the corresponding data table.

- Creating a download job through this API triggers an [AMQP message push](~~143601~~). Use `dop_aliyun_group_name` as the `consumerGroupId`. The message content includes the execution status of this download job. You can use this status together with the [GetDownloadFile](~~445783~~) API to obtain the file download URL or view abnormal information about the download job.

## Limits

- Only one download job can be created at a time under the same data instance. You must wait until the previous job finishes before creating a new one. Otherwise, an exception indicating that the limit on the number of download jobs has been exceeded is returned.

- The maximum time range for data in a single download is 3 days.

- You can create up to 3 download jobs per day. Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-download-data-job --iot-instance-id iot-cn-npk1u000000 --table-name product_info --download-data-type TABLE --file-config fileName=fileName01 --start-time 1658332800000 --end-time 1658406464534 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateDownloadDataJob --region cn-hangzhou --TableName product_info --FileConfig '{"fileName":"fileName01"}' --DownloadDataType TABLE --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-npk1u000000' --EndTime 1658406464534 --StartTime 1658332800000
